responsibility: This file emits all non-instruction assembler output for GCC, including variables, constants, aliases, weak/external declarations, trampolines, section switches, and constant pools. It owns the compiler’s section objects and current-section state, logic for constant merging and validation of static initializers, object naming and COMDAT handling, target-default section and visibility helpers, and the assembly of data, strings, constructors/destructors, and exception-related object sections.
same_name_distinction: Implements the varasm stem's assembler-output and section-management logic, owning section objects, COMDAT switching, constant emission, and non-instruction assembly output. Unlike gcc/varasm.h, which just declares the interface, this file contains the actual emission and section-selection code.
